lines.trans: Vitya, what is going on with us?
Kristina just came up to me.
She said that the restaurant is closing tomorrow.
And if Dima comes up, to send him far away.
Then Dima came up and said the exact same thing.
We do not need to send anyone anywhere.
Tomorrow we will have two banquets at once.
They will not even see each other.
Max, what are you doing right now?
Vika, forgive me, I did not mean to at all.
Here, I brought you clean salt.
Listen, you still have sauce on you, let me hold it.
